title: My Mega One-shot prompt: Show me what yours came up with!
author: shinobi-elf
selftext:
Prompt: [https://hastebin.com/share/qeyuxizafa.bash](https://hastebin.com/share/qeyuxizafa.bash)

TLDR; Upload prompt file into your AI agent and say "Use this file to build my project."

*Read more if you want to customize it or want a more seamless experience.*  
  
*If you're paranoid, it's a text file...attach it as a file to Gemini or whoever to check for malicious prompts or whatever to get your peace of mind.*

>**\*\*\* SHARE YOUR RESULTS! \*\*\***  


    QUICK START
    
    1. Open ONE-SHOT-PROMPT.txt.
    2. Check the QUICK CONFIG block near the top for choices, or leave them unchanged and let the AI make the remaining decisions. Examples:
       %Options=1 — Ask customization questions
       %Theme=3 — Pirate cove
       %Character=2 — HD Chibi Ninja
       %Character=3 — Momo (optional reference image)
       %Character=4 — Slime (default/fallback)
       %StartStyle=1 — Photoreal
       %maxusage=2 — Two-hour work budget
       %RecordVideo=1 — Include video recording (default); 2 turns it off
    3. Optional: attach Momo's reference image when choosing Character 3.
    4. Paste the complete prompt into your AI tool. Let it work and answer any questions or required permissions.
    
    An AI that can create files is easiest. A text-only chatbot requires you to save its code yourself. If it stops early, say “Continue where you left off.” Time settings cannot override your AI tool's limits. Slime is used unless another character is selected; an explicit Momo choice still works from its written description without the image.
    
    OPTIONAL: PREPARE THREE.JS
    
    Download: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/archive/refs/tags/r186.zip
    Before starting, right-click the downloaded ZIP → Extract All. Put the extracted three.js-r186 folder inside your project folder and tell the AI: “Use the extracted local Three.js folder.” Keep its files together. This helps only when the AI can access your folder; a web chatbot cannot automatically read files on your computer. This ZIP contains the library, not a finished world.
    
    VIEW YOUR WORLD
    
    Open the AI's preview link if provided. Otherwise open the finished project folder in VS Code. Install Live Server yourself if needed, then right-click index.html → Open with Live Server. Follow the project's README for controls. Use a local server instead of simply double-clicking index.html. No Vite, npm build or in-app browser is needed.
    
    VS Code: https://code.visualstudio.com/
    Live Server: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ritwickdey.LiveServer
    
    SHOWCASE AND RECORD VIDEO
    
    The app should include a cinematic Showcase and Record Video controls by default. Open the Video/Showcase panel, choose a tour or play normally, click Start Recording, then Stop and Save/Download. It records your world locally, not your webcam or microphone. Recording never starts automatically. Browser support varies; expect the actual supported format, often WebM, and a clear message if recording isn't available. The AI must report any untested or unsupported recording feature.
    
    TL;DR
    
    Check the QUICK CONFIG block near the top → paste the whole prompt into your AI → let it build → open the finished project with Live Server → use Video/Showcase to record when you choose. Slime and video controls are defaults. The Momo image and advance Three.js download are optional.
